calls.video_title: How I'm Investing With $1.5 Million Stock Portfolio
calls.thesis: A buy today — selloff on temporary beef-inflation EPS hit (-5% EPS, -16% net income) while revenue, restaurant count, weekly sales, same-store sales and to-go all grow; management plays the long game on pricing.
calls.bull_case: When beef prices fall, net income rebounds sharply; customer trust preserved via stable pricing.
